text:
rafa: quick sync 10am 1pm: Orchid Labs wants a Private POC. Requirements: customer HSM root keys + KMS-wrapped secrets + short-lived client certs. who owns presales handoff?
sophia: I can take this. Need a compact checklist and clear transfer options (PKCS#11 over VPN preferred). want to reduce loops with security.
kevin: Security preference: PKCS#11 with vendor attestation for production. POC: SCEP+OIDC or manual CSR allowed as fallback but flagged limited. must get CA chain and HSM firmware info.
rafa: ok list the exact artifacts we need so i can send to their infra lead.
sophia: Draft checklist: 1) CA cert chain (PEM) 2) HSM vendor/model/firmware + PKCS#11 module path OR SCEP URL + OIDC client creds 3) Key policy (non-exportable, allowed ops) 4) CSR (if manual) 5) Management-plane allowlist CIDRs + bastion details 6) Bastion SSH pubkey 7) Desired cert TTL & rotation cadence 8) SIEM endpoint for audit forwarding
kevin: add: PKCS#11 sign test (we'll provide nonce orchid-onboard-<ts>), attestation cert/quote, and any SOC2/ISO evidence they can share. also request key usage flags.
sophia: transport options to propose: A) PKCS#11 via customer VPN/bastion (preferred) B) SCEP + OIDC C) secure upload (short-lived S3 presigned PUTs or scoped SFTP). recommend A for prod; allow B/C for POC but note limited attestation.
kevin: include a minimal PKCS#11 CSR example they can run on their HSM host to avoid back-and-forth:
```
# run on customer's HSM host
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/vendor_pkcs11.so -l --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 --label orchid_key
openssl req -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine -new -key "pkcs11:object=orchid_key;type=private" -out orchid.csr -subj "/CN=orchid-client/O=OrchidLabs"
```
sophia: What we return: short-lived client certs (TTL 24h-7d per their preference), revocation API (OCSP/CRL), and an attestation token for the Dedicated pool.
rafa: also ask if they want model pinning to Dedicated or fallback to hosted during overload 1 impacts capacity & pricing.
kevin: security follow-ups: ATO statement for the POC, PKCS#11 sign vector, and their compromise/rotation plan.
deploy-bot: :ticket: INF-9001 created: "orchid private-poc hsm+kms cert exchange" 2 assignee: sophia 2 due: 3 business days 2 https://rwd.atlassian/INF-9001
sophia: timeline to Orchid: please provide chosen transport + artifacts within 5 business days so we can target a 2-week POC start. i'll draft the kickoff email + attach checklist and pkcs11 example.
rafa: thanks team. i'll message Orchid infra now and post their transfer choice here. :rocket:
